title: The Black Claw Captures the Heart
overview: Kisaragi Honey finds out she isn't your typical teenager after her father is murdered by Panther Claw. She discovers she is actually a transforming android. And inside her is the Fixed System of Air Elements. Panther Claw desires the amazing system. Now aware of her origins, Honey vows revenge on Panther Claw for the death of her father.

title: Fire Peony of the Night Dance of Swords
overview: Sister Jill destroyed a famous Picasso statue in hopes of luring out Honey. During this attack, Seiji was severely injured and sent to a hospital. Upon arrival Honey discovers Panther Claw has taken control of the hospital. There Fire Claw awaits to steal the Fixed System of Air Elements.

title: The Red Axe Lays a Trap
overview: A new jewelry store is giving away free jewels during their grand opening. However, the store is in fact a plan devised by Tomahawk Panther to trap Honey. When Honey discovers this, she exposes the jeweler' s true identity. But Tomahawk turns the tables by taking Seiji hostage...

title: The Devil Spotted in the Beautiful Forest
overview: The Museum of Antiques was successfully stolen by Badfly Claw and her minions. With Seiji back in the hospital, Danbei assists Honey against her battle with Badfly Claw. But what will Honey do when Danbei ends up a hostage?

title: The Crimson Sky, The Devil's Curse
overview: Taranche Panther absconded with an Egyptian Crown with a value of 5,000,000 yen. When Honey tries to return the crown, she ends up getting captured. Taranche hijacks a plane to hand deliver both Honey and the crown to Panther Zora...
